hatch.comment: The arranging hatch's line: strong at 60% over the sheet. A board under construction draws its diagonals in it, and so does a note standing on that board, which is why it is a colour of its own and not the strong border faded on a layer.

control.comment: A step the kit draws: the design draws no control boundary; it starts from the neutral mark. Placed where every rule holds.

field.comment: The strong border, #d4d4d8, darkened dE 24.64: the least move that clears 3:1 on every rung a text field sits on (3.03:1 on the raised rung, the worst). A field stands on a rung and never inside a hovered or pressed row, so it is held to the rungs alone rather than to the composites the control boundary clears, and it reads as quietly as a secondary button's edge allows.
